summary_en: FY2027/3 annual dividend raised from ¥114 to ¥121 per share: ordinary ¥114 + 70th-anniversary special ¥7. Q2 interim ¥64 (ordinary ¥57 + special ¥7); year-end ¥57 (ordinary). Payout ratio currently 45%+; company to consider increasing target threshold going forward. Seven consecutive periods without reduction.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase via 70th-Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: NICHIHA Corporation announced on 31 July 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027. The company, having reached its 70th anniversary on 25 June 2026, resolved to pay an additional commemorative dividend alongside the ordinary dividend as a token of gratitude to shareholders. The full-year dividend is now projected at ¥121 per share, comprising ordinary dividends of ¥114 and a special 70th-anniversary dividend of ¥7. This is distributed as ¥64 at the second quarter (¥57 ordinary + ¥7 special) and ¥57 at the year-end (ordinary only). The previous forecast, issued on 13 May 2026, was ¥114 per share. The company has maintained zero reductions across seven consecutive periods. Going forward, NICHIHA targets annual dividends of at least ¥121 per share. To sustain this level, the company stated it will consider raising its payout ratio threshold in its second-phase medium-term management plan, currently set at 45% or higher.
